# Restake ETH — Restaking Staked ETH & LSTs Reference

> Use ETH that is already staked — native staked ETH or a liquid staking token (LST) receipt — to help secure additional services (AVSs) on top of Ethereum for extra rewards. Builds on Ethereum staking, non-custodial, with compounded slashing risk. Independent, not affiliated with any restaking protocol.

## Key Facts
- Restaking: opting already-staked ETH (native staked ETH or an stETH-style LST) in to secure extra services on top of Ethereum
- Builds ON TOP of Ethereum staking — understand ordinary ETH staking first
- AVSs (Actively Validated Services) / modules: the extra services restakers, or the operators they delegate to, help secure
- Rewards: paid as tokens or as points; points are NOT guaranteed to convert to tokens; no specific APR/points value promised
- Custody: non-custodial — your wallet signs; restaking runs through public smart contracts; you delegate to an operator
- Risks: compounded/additional slashing on top of Ethereum's own, AVS/operator risk, smart-contract risk, illiquidity and withdrawal delays, points-not-guaranteed risk
- Independent resource — NOT affiliated with or endorsed by any restaking protocol
